_doc: SEASON-005: the village elder's seasonal tasks. seasons: {spring|summer|autumn|winter: {tasks: [exactly 3 {id (globally unique), text (non-empty), kind, target, count (int 1..5)}], payout: {stones (int >= 0), renown (int >= 0, in Qingshi Village), favor_all (int >= 0, favor with every villager of Qingshi Village), item (optional items.json id, one given)}}}. kind: catch (target = an items.json fish id; counts fish caught), gather (target = an items.json id; counts units gathered or foraged), hunt (target = an enemies.json id; counts wins), contest (target = a world_events.json id with a contest; counts entries), sell_wanted (target ''; counts units sold to a market's wanted-item bonus). restoration (optional, SEASON-006): {region (regions.json id), name (e.g. "the old shrine"), stages: [1..8 {flag (unique world flag), text}], qi_flag: {flag (unique), bonus (0 < b <= 0.1), text}, incense (optional, SEASON-007): {item (items.json id), flag (unique world flag), days (int 1..3), bonus (0 < b <= 0.1), text (non-empty)}}: each season whose three tasks are finished (CharacterData.seasons_completed, unique season keys) repairs one stage and sets its world flag; when all are reached qi_flag.flag is set too, and the region must list that flag with the same bonus in its qi_flags. Once restored, the shrine takes one `incense` item (SeasonTasks.offer_incense) and sets the timed world flag {until: day + days}; the region must list that flag with the same bonus too. projects (optional, SEASON-008): after the shrine, further village projects in order: [{id, name, region (regions.json id), stages: [1..8 {flag (unique), text}], done_text, crop_bonus (optional, 0 < b <= 0.1: per stage reached, the fraction of an extra growing day per day for crops in field plots of that region), daily (optional): {item (items.json id), flag (unique timed world flag), text}}]; finished seasons beyond the shrine fill the next project (SeasonTasks.project_stage); SeasonTasks.draw_daily gives one daily item once whole. Progress lives in CharacterData.season_tasks and resets when the season changes; SeasonTasks.note adds to it and pays the reward once when all three are done.

stages.text: Villagers clear the weeds and rubble from the old shrine.
A new roof of grey tile goes up over the old shrine.
The old shrine's cracked altar stone is set straight and polished.
Incense is lit at the old shrine for the first time in a generation.

incense.text: Incense smoke curls from the old shrine.

projects.name: the Founder's Old Well

stages.text: Villagers haul the rotten cover off the Founder's Old Well and bail out the muck.
Masons re-lay the well's fallen stones and hang a new windlass.
Clear water rises in the Founder's Old Well for the first time in a generation.

projects.done_text: The old well is whole: Qingshi's fields grow faster, and you may draw well water once a day.

daily.text: You draw a bucket of cold, sweet water from the old well.

tasks.text: Land a Peach-Blossom Bream from the village pond.
Gather 3 Peach Blossom Petals for the shrine.
Drive off a Fog-Antler Stag that is trampling the fields.
Land a Lotus Bass from the forest pond.
Gather 2 Qi Condensing Grass for the elder's tonic.
Race in the Dragon Boat Festival.
Land a Maple Roach for the harvest table.
Hunt a Mist Fox that raids the granaries.
Sell 2 of a stall's wanted goods at the market.
Land an Ice Perch for the winter feast.
Hunt a Den Wolf that prowls near the village.
